items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 27 May 2026 6:14am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

East 4 or 5, increasing East or SE 5 or 6 in the evening, then possibly occasionally 7 in a few places for a time tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate tonight.


##Weather)##

Fair, then scattered showers tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at times.


##Wind)##

SE 5 or 6, soon decreasing 4 or 5 in. Gradually veering South or SW in the afternoon and evening, possibly increasing 6 around west of island at times, then SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, then risk of mist and fog patches for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.
